Rajendra Singh Negi
--Petitioner
 Versus

--Respondents
With Connected Matters
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Tapan Singh, learned counsel for the 
petitioner(s).
2. Mr. Puran Singh Bisht, learned C.S.C. along 
with Mr. Narayan Dutt, learned Standing Counsel for 
the State.
3. Mr. Tapan Singh, learned counsel appearing for 
the petitioner(s), submits that all these writ petitions 
are squarely covered by the judgment passed by a 
Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in WPSS No.609 of 
2020, Ramchandra Tomar vs. State of Uttarakhand & 
Others and connected matters. Subsequently, other 
writ petitions involving the same lis have also been 
decided in terms of the aforesaid judgment. In those 
matters, State had made a statement before the 
Bench that the issues involved were squarely covered 
by the aforesaid judgment in Ram Chandra Tomar 
(Supra). Accordingly, it is submitted that the present 
writ petitions may also be decided in terms of the 
said judgment.
4. Learned C.S.C. has requested this Court to 
once again get instructions from the State and verify 
the position, so as to avoid any difficulty at a later  stage.
5. In such view of the matter, put up these writ 
petitions on 18.09.2026 immediately after fresh 
cases.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
08.09.2026 AK
